message.peterwolfs_forestfire.incident_a: INCIDENT ALERT: %s near %s, %s, %s — respond with pump, hose and command post.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.pump_damag: Pump is damaged and cannot start.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.pump_no_fu: Pump has no fuel. Use a Pump Fuel Can.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_no_: No pressurised hose nearby. Deploy attack line from the pump.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_nee: Connect nozzle to a Portable Pump (right-click the pump). Carry Hose Rolls for length.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_no_: No pump pressure. Check intake, fuel and pump state.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_pic: Nozzle ready — LPM = water, double-LPM = continuous, PPM = stream mode. Shift+PPM place.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_pla: Nozzle placed on the ground. Water closed.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_con: Nozzle connected — automatic attack hose deployed.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_in_: Another firefighter is operating this nozzle.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_orp: Nozzle link lost — reconnect to a pump.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_no_: Cannot drop a connected nozzle. Shift-place on ground or disconnect at pump.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_flo: Continuous water ON (double LPM) — LPM again to stop.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.hose_maxim: Hose at maximum length — cannot go further.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.hose_insuf: Cannot connect hose: insufficient hose length
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.hose_ancho: No nearby hose route to anchor.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.intake_inv: Cannot connect intake: invalid water source
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.intake_por: Cannot connect intake: pump intake already connected
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.connector_: Right-click a pump port first (back face = intake, front = output).
Intake selected — right-click water, tank or strainer.
Output selected — right-click nozzle or splitter.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.backpack_e: Backpack sprayer empty. Sneak-use near water to refill.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.kit_given: Firefighter kit granted (%s stacks). Full gear, tools, pump, hoses and fuel.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.peterwolf: Dedicated to all firefighters who risk their lives protecting forests, wildlife and communities.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_wro: This nozzle is assigned to a different pump.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.hose_roll_: Right-click the Portable Pump with the hose roll first.
Intake ready (%s m) — right-click water, tank or strainer.
Attack hose ready (%s m) — right-click nozzle on pump, or ground nozzle / splitter.
Attack side selected — place nozzle (right-click pump with nozzle) or click ground nozzle / splitter.
